description: Barrier taxonomy v0 — why users hesitate to explore or buy unfamiliar categories.

barriers.name: Trust / quality risk
barriers.description: Fear that unfamiliar products or brands will be low quality, fake, or inconsistent.

barriers.name: Price / value uncertainty
barriers.description: Unclear whether the price is fair versus kirana, supermarket, or known brands.
examples: Not sure if worth the money

barriers.name: Freshness / spoilage fear
barriers.description: Worry that perishables will arrive stale, near expiry, or poorly handled.

barriers.name: Substitution / brand lock-in
barriers.description: Strong preference for a known brand or SKU; unwilling to substitute.

barriers.name: Discovery invisibility
barriers.description: User does not see or notice other categories; assortment feels invisible in the journey.

barriers.name: Search vocabulary gap
barriers.description: User cannot formulate the right query or synonyms; search fails to surface the category.

barriers.name: Assortment doubt
barriers.description: Belief that the platform lacks depth, preferred variants, sizes, or specialty items.

barriers.name: Habit / mental model
barriers.description: Platform is mentally slotted for only a few use cases (e.g. emergency snacks).
examples: I use it for basics only

barriers.name: Time / cognitive load
barriers.description: Exploring new categories feels effortful; user wants fast reorder of known items.

barriers.name: Past bad experience
barriers.description: A previous negative order in that category blocks retry or adjacent exploration.

barriers.name: Missing information before trying
barriers.description: Needs more info (expiry, origin, ingredients, reviews, unit price) before experimenting.

barriers.name: Other / unspecified
barriers.description: Barrier present but not covered by taxonomy; queue for taxonomy revision.

barriers.name: No exploration barrier
barriers.description: Feedback is positive or unrelated to category exploration hesitation.
